claim: This is a historical coverage map and acquisition plan, NOT an exhaustive edition.

families.title: Avicenna and earliest appropriations
works: Ibn Sīnā — al-Shifāʾ: Ilāhiyyāt, Ṭabīʿiyyāt, Nafs
families.task: Reconstruct which claims were transmitted as mathematical/natural science, metaphysics, psychology and logic before later school labels.

families.title: Rāzian critical transformation
families.task: Recover each Rāzian objection in its own chapter and follow the particular response, not just its later scholastic citation.

families.title: Abharī, Khūnajī, Urmawī and Kātibī
works: Athīr al-Dīn al-Abharī — Hidāyat al-ḥikma, Kashf al-ḥaqāʾiq
Afḍal al-Dīn al-Khūnajī — Kashf al-asrār, al-Jumal
Najm al-Dīn al-Kātibī — Ḥikmat al-ʿayn, al-Shamsiyya
families.task: Distinguish revised modal logic and subject matter of logic from the related, but distinct, natural-philosophy treatises.

families.title: The Ishārāt commentary-and-adjudication cycle
works: Naṣīr al-Dīn al-Ṭūsī — Ḥall mushkilāt al-Ishārāt
families.task: Translate the common Avicennian lemma plus Rāzī's objection, Ṭūsī's answer and Quṭb's adjudication as one documented debate.

families.title: The Tajrīd, Kashf and Sharḥ commentary trees
works: Dawwānī, Dashtakī, al-Khafrī, Lāhījī and later superglosses
families.task: Always anchor each commentary to the identical matn sentence and distinguish opposite disputants and reported testimony.

families.title: Post-Rāzian philosophical kalām
works: Siyālkūtī, Ḥasan Çelebi, Ḥalabī and other gloss layers
families.task: Separate matn, sharḥ, gloss and cited objection; identify the epistemic thesis actually being disputed.

families.title: Shamsiyya, second intentions and disputation
works: Shams al-Dīn al-Samarqandī — works on logic and ādāb al-baḥth
Indian, Ottoman and North African supercommentaries
families.task: Treat logical arguments and philosophy of language as primary parts of late Avicennism, not metaphysical appendices.

families.title: Illuminationist revisions and responses
works: Ibn Kammūna — commentaries and al-Jadīd fī l-ḥikma
Quṭb al-Dīn al-Shīrāzī — Sharḥ Ḥikmat al-ishrāq
families.task: Compare logical, ontological and epistemic revisions with their precise Avicennian target.

families.title: Akbarian philosophical and theological encounters
works: Jāmī and later Akbarian interpretive works
families.task: Trace explicit borrowings and disagreements on wujūd, causality and divine knowledge; do not equate every use of tajallī with numerical monism.

families.title: Late Timurid and Shiraz disputations
works: Ghiyāth al-Dīn Manṣūr al-Dashtakī — philosophical works
families.task: Separate the Dawwānī–Dashtakī exchange from al-Sayyid al-Sanad (generally Jurjānī).

families.title: Safavid Isfahan and competing Avicennisms
works: Mullā Ṣadrā — al-Asfār and Shifāʾ glosses
Mullā Muḥsin Fayḍ and Rajab ʿAlī Tabrīzī
Lāhījī, Khwānsārī and Sabzawārī correspondence and glosses
families.task: Distinguish Ṣadrian new metaphysics from the independent Peripatetic and kalām responses of his contemporaries. The later Narāqī/Sabzavārī reception of Ṣadrian issues is crosslinked separately from this Safavid stream, not reclassified as Safavid contemporaries.

families.title: Late Persian, Qajar and Tehran school
works: Muḥammad Mahdī al-Narāqī — Jāmiʿ al-afkār, Lamaʿāt
Mullā ʿAlī Nūrī and Mullā Hādī Sabzawārī
families.task: Recover direct texts on substantial motion, particular existence, soul and physics, instead of assigning group-level doctrines. Direct Narāqī *Jāmiʿ al-afkār* II:25–27 and Sabzavārī *Sharḥ al-Manẓūma* IV:301–302, 305 are now bounded working dossiers, NOT complete surrounding proofs.

families.title: Ottoman and Kurdish-province Hidāya chain
families.task: Work through one full Hidāya lemma, Maybudī's commentary, Lārī's gloss, later reply and Turkish translation before claiming the doctrine settled.

families.title: South Asian Shifāʾ, Mawāqif and Dars-e-Niẓāmī
works: Qāḍī Mubārak Shāh and further ḥawāshī
Safavid Shifāʾ commentary manuscripts preserved in India
families.task: Differentiate historical authors and manuscript copy/transmission from original composition; do not confuse Faḍl-i Ḥaqq and Muḥammad ʿAbd al-Ḥaqq.

families.title: Western Islamic logic and Khūnajī's Jumal
works: Ibn Wāṣil / Urmawī lines received westward
families.task: The western logic tradition was broadly post-Avicennian but not a mere copy of eastern al-Shamsiyya teaching.

families.title: Modern editorial and teaching continuations
works: Persian explanatory commentary on the Ishārāt
Critical editions of medieval and early modern scholastic works
Modern philosophical reconstruction and reception studies
families.task: Place contemporary scholarship apart from historical authorial witnesses; distinguish modern pedagogy from new primary doctrinal positions.

requirements: Historical family -> base work -> work division -> chapter/masʾala -> identical lemma -> objections/replies
Direct witness or later author's report labelled without substitution
Original-language translation from enough consecutive context, not keyword snippets
Variant collation and edition page/folio independently checked
Reader comparison justified explicitly, with connection and difference
Unsupported families displayed as unedited, not absent from history

statusLegend.partial-primary: Bounded material present but no complete family corpus
statusLegend.no-primary-unit: No directly translated primary unit in current corpus
statusLegend.untranslated-original: Named original texts not independently translated
statusLegend.topic-only: Some related concepts present but not adequate primary coverage
